row.evidence: Freshsales' pricing page (Growth $9, Pro $39, Enterprise $59 per user/mo billed annually) lists no SCIM or provisioning, and the Freshworks IdP apps (Okta, Entra, Google, JumpCloud) are SAML SSO only; the Freshsales SSO article applies SSO to Free, Growth, Pro and Enterprise.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence: no SCIM endpoint in the Freshsales API reference, no SCIM article in the crmsupport.freshworks.com or support.freshworks.com help centres, and no SCIM on the pricing page. SSO (SAML, OIDC, OAuth, JWT) is configured at the Freshworks organization (Neo Admin Center) level and the Freshsales SSO article marks all four plans. The shared Freshworks Okta, Entra, Google and JumpCloud apps are SSO only; Entra says users must be created before SSO. The REST API has no user create/update/delete endpoints, only a read-only api/selector/owners list. Free plan ($0, up to 3 users) appears on the comparison page but not on the main pricing page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Shown only on the plan-comparison page; the main pricing page lists Growth, Pro and Enterprise.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit logs (UI) listed on Enterprise only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented in the Freshsales API reference or help centres; Freshworks IdP apps are SSO only.

endpoints.purpose: Fetch all existing users (id, name) in the Freshsales portal; read-only

audit_log_api.notes: No audit-log endpoint in the API reference; audit logs (UI) are on Enterprise.

rate_limits.text: 1000 API requests per hour per account.

limitations.text: The REST API (CRM records) has no user-management endpoints; users can only be listed read-only via api/selector/owners. List responses paginate at 25 objects per page by default.

user_api.notes: available=false because the API offers no user create, update or remove; only a read-only owners selector.

okta.notes: Shared "Freshworks" OIN app (covers Freshdesk, Freshsales, Freshchat, Freshcaller, Freshmarketer); the rendered page checks SAML only, no SCIM or provisioning. No product-specific or Aquera connector for this product appears in an OIN search for "fresh".

entra.notes: Shared "Freshworks" gallery app is SSO only; users must exist in Freshworks before SSO. No Freshworks provisioning tutorial (freshworks-provisioning-tutorial returns 404).

google.notes: Freshworks is in Google's pre-integrated SAML catalogue; not in Google's autoprovisioning list.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin catalogue not loaded (blocks bots); Freshworks' SSO guide lists a OneLogin SAML configuration but no provisioning.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud's Freshworks guide covers SAML SSO only.
